decisions.reason: The accelerator is shown on the home page and supports the firm's announced green-innovation identity, so management will likely keep it despite its distance from core machinery, though it costs little to quietly discontinue.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder has its own page and fits the sustainability narrative, so management will attribute slow uptake to long road-construction approval cycles and persist, although it is the least visible of the four.
The WASTX Cleanic was publicly launched on the home page as a 'revolutionary' partnership with ERMAFA, so the investment and public commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
The SNOWFLAKE is the latest flagship of the WASTX recycling line, which is central to the firm's announced direction, so management will keep investing in it.
